Name: Only Fishing Vibration
Author: Solaris710
Description:
Simple mod to disable controller vibration except when a fish bites.

Leave vibration on ingame, and your controller will only vibrate when you land a fish. Optionally vibration can be turned on by editing the config file in the mod folder.

Requires SMAPI, newest recommended. Install by unzipping and dragging the folder to your mods folder.

2.0 update: fixed up the mod, now vibration only happens when you land a fish instead of the entire time. Minigame vibration can optionally be re-enabled.

Manifest.Name: Only Fishing Rumble
Manifest.Description: Disables all controller rumble except the moment a fish bites (the fishing 'hit'). Configurable.
